spec.description: Compare Proxmox-reported guest CPU/memory (InfluxDB, PVE metric server) with node exporter (inside the VM) and cAdvisor container totals. Select a Proxmox guest — node and cAdvisor targets are linked automatically via the proxmox_guest label in Alloy.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object != "nodes" and r.host == "${guest}" and r._field == "status")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object != "nodes" and r.host == "${guest}" and r._field == "mem")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Proxmox used"})

spec.title: Memory gap
spec.description: Positive values mean node exporter reports more usage than Proxmox.

spec.expr: sum(container_memory_rss{job="cadvisor", proxmox_guest="$guest", name=~".+"}) - on() group_left() (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="prometheus.scrape.node_exporter", proxmox_guest="$guest"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="prometheus.scrape.node_exporter", proxmox_guest="$guest"})

spec.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object != "nodes" and r.host == "${guest}" and r._field == "mem")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

spec.title: CPU gap
spec.description: Positive values mean node exporter reports higher CPU % than Proxmox guest view.

spec.expr: (100 * sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor", proxmox_guest="$guest", name=~".+"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(count(count by (cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="prometheus.scrape.node_exporter", proxmox_guest="$guest", mode="idle"})), 1)) - on() group_left() (100 - (avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="prometheus.scrape.node_exporter", proxmox_guest="$guest", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100))

spec.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object != "nodes" and r.host == "${guest}" and r._field == "cpu")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) * 100.0}))

options.content:
**How to use:** pick a Proxmox guest — Alloy links node exporter and cAdvisor via the `proxmox_guest` label.

| Guest | Node instance | cAdvisor |
|---|---|---|
| [internal-services](?var-guest=internal-services) | database-vm | yes |
| [prod-apps](?var-guest=prod-apps) | prod-docker-server | yes |
| [monitoring-stack](?var-guest=monitoring-stack) | — | yes (local cadvisor) |
| [Alpine-Jellyfin](?var-guest=Alpine-Jellyfin) | zinohub (192.168.0.33) | **no** — Docker runs on the VM but cAdvisor is not deployed there |
| [qbit-linux](?var-guest=qbit-linux) | qbit | no |
| [ark](?var-guest=ark) | ark-server (on-demand) | yes |
| [mc-server](?var-guest=mc-server) | minecraft (on-demand) | no |
| [ng-alpine](?var-guest=ng-alpine) | nginx | no |

Proxmox guest CPU is % of allocated vCPUs. Node exporter CPU is % of all VM cores. cAdvisor CPU is container CPU summed and normalized to VM core count.

  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.object}))

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object != "nodes" and r.host == "${guest}" and r._field == "cpus")
